$comment: A validation target: an external DPP model at one version, hosted as GITB validation types by OpenEPCIS DPP-Ready. Types are derived from the crosswalk profile; artifacts are checked against the vendor MANIFEST.json on every build. See docs/GITB_CONFORMANCE.md, section 'External models'.
title: EU DPP Registry semantic data artifacts

publicOnly._comment: Files that describe the passport header, which only the public view carries: the Commission's res1 to res3 examples hold the restricted fields alone.

accepted.reason: Release 1.0.0 accepts a language-tagged text only with a region subtag (en-IE); plain BCP 47 tags such as en are rejected, and OpenEPCIS data has no region to add (crosswalk README, eu-dpp gap 1).

accepted.reason: Release 1.0.0 accepts a model identifier only together with a batch number, so an item passport with a serial number but no batch cannot name its model (crosswalk README, eu-dpp gap 2).
